name: sonic
description: Sonic Music Cloud Platform & Aggregation Gateway (by EpoCanvas)

scripts.build: cd player && pnpm build && cd .. && rm -rf dist && cp -r player/dist dist && cp -n favicon.png favicon.svg dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build:engine: esbuild server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist-server/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && (${WRANGLER_BIN:-npx wrangler} pages deploy dist --project-name=${CF_PAGES_PROJECT:-cfsolara} --branch=${CF_PAGES_BRANCH:-main} --commit-dirty=true)
scripts.test: jiti scripts/test-sonic-gateway.mjs && jiti scripts/test-auth-compatibility.mjs && jiti scripts/test-cover-gateway.mjs && jiti scripts/test-local-engine-and-degradation.mjs
